Package org.apache.beam.sdk.transforms.display

@DefaultAnnotation(org.checkerframework.checker.nullness.qual.NonNull.class) package org.apache.beam.sdk.transforms.display
Defines HasDisplayData for annotating components which provide display data used within UIs and diagnostic tools.
